titleEnglish: The Noble Qualities of the Prophet ﷺ

verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكْمَلَ النَّاسِ خَلْقًا وَخُلُقًا ذَا ذَاتٍ وَصِفَاتٍ سَنِيَّةْ ۞ مَرْبُوعَ الْقَامَةِ أَبْيَضَ اللَّوْنِ مُشْرَبًا بِحُمْرَةٍ وَاسِعَ الْعَيْنَيْنِ أَكْحَلَهُمَا أَهْدَبَ الْأَشْفَارِ قَدْ مُنِحَ الزَّجَجَ حَاجِبَاهْ ۞ مُفَلَّجَ الْأَسْنَانِ وَاسِعَ الْفَمِ حَسَنَهُ وَاسِعَ الْجَبِينِ ذَا جَبْهَةٍ هِلَالِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-kāna ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama akmala n-nāsi khalqan wa-khuluqan dhā dhātin wa-ṣifātin saniyyah, marbūʿa l-qāmati abyaḍa l-lawni mushraban bi-ḥumratin wāsiʿa l-ʿaynayni akḥalahumā ahdaba l-ashfāri qad muniḥa z-zajaja ḥājibāh, mufallaja l-asnāni wāsiʿa l-fami ḥasanahu wāsiʿa l-jabīni dhā jabhatin hilāliyyah.
verses.en: He, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, was the most perfect of all people in form and character, possessing a noble being and sublime attributes. He was of medium stature, fair in complexion with a tinge of redness, with wide eyes that appeared naturally lined with kohl, long eyelashes, and fine, arched eyebrows. His teeth were slightly spaced, his mouth broad and handsome, and his forehead wide and crescent-shaped.

verses.ar: سَهْلَ الْخَدَّيْنِ يُرَى فِي أَنْفِهِ بَعْضُ احْدِيدَابٍ حَسَنَ الْعِرْنِيْنِ أَقْنَاهْ ۞ بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ سَبْطَ الْكَفَّيْنِ ضَخْمَ الْكَرَادِيسِ قَلِيلَ لَحْمِ الْعَقِبِ كَثَّ اللِّحْيَةِ عَظِيمَ الرَّأْسِ شَعْرُهُ إِلَى الشَّحْمَةِ الْأُذُنِيَّةْ ۞ وَبَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ خَاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ قَدْ عَمَّهُ النُّورُ وَعَلَاهْ
verses.tr: Sahla l-khaddayni yurā fī anfihi baʿḍu ḥdīdābin ḥasana l-ʿirnīni aqnāh, baʿīda mā bayna l-mankibayni sabṭa l-kaffayni ḍakhma l-karādīsi qalīla laḥmi l-ʿaqibi kaththa l-liḥyati ʿaẓīma r-ra'si shaʿruhu ilā sh-shaḥmati l-udhuniyyah, wa-bayna katifayhi khātamu n-nubuwwati qad ʿammahu n-nūru wa-ʿalāh.
verses.en: His cheeks were smooth, and a slight curve could be seen in his nose, which was handsome and aquiline. His shoulders were broad, his palms smooth, his joints large, and there was little flesh upon his heels. His beard was full, his head large, and his hair reached his earlobes. And between his shoulders was the Seal of Prophethood, encompassed and covered by light.

verses.ar: وَعَرَقُهُ كَاللُّؤْلُؤِ وَعَرْفُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنَ النَّفَحَاتِ الْمِسْكِيَّةْ ۞ وَيَتَكَفَّأُ فِي مِشْيَتِهِ كَأَنَّمَا يَنْحَطُّ مِنْ صَبَبٍ ارْتَقَاهْ ۞ وَكَانَ يُصَافِحُ الْمُصَافِحَ بِيَدِهِ الشَّرِيفَةِ فَيَجِدُ مِنْهَا سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ رَائِحَةً عَبْهَرِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿaraquhu ka-l-lu'lu'i wa-ʿarfuhu aṭyabu mina n-nafaḥāti l-miskiyyah, wa-yatakaffa'u fī mishyatihi ka-annamā yanḥaṭṭu min ṣababin irtaqāh, wa-kāna yuṣāfiḥu l-muṣāfiḥa bi-yadihi sh-sharīfati fa-yajidu minhā sā'ira l-yawmi rā'iḥatan ʿabhariyyah.
verses.en: His perspiration was like pearls, and his fragrance was sweeter than musky breezes. And when he walked, he moved with a forward-leaning stride, as though descending from a height. And when he shook someone’s hand with his noble hand, that person would find its exquisite fragrance lingering throughout the rest of the day.

verses.ar: وَيَضَعُهَا عَلٰى رَأْسِ الصَّبِيِّ فَيُعْرَفُ مَسُّهُ لَهُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصِّبْيَةِ وَيُدْرَاهْ ۞ يَتَلَأْلَأُ وَجْهُهُ الشَّرِيفُ تَلَأْلُؤَ الْقَمَرِ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْبَدْرِيَّةْ ۞ يَقُولُ نَاعِتُهُ لَمْ أَرَ قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَا بَشَرٌ يَرَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-yaḍaʿuhā ʿalā ra'si ṣ-ṣabiyyi fa-yuʿrafu massuhu lahu min bayni ṣ-ṣibyati wa-yudrāh, yatala'la'u wajhuhu sh-sharīfu tala'lu'a l-qamari fī l-laylati l-badriyyah, yaqūlu nāʿituhu lam ara qablahu wa-lā baʿdahu mithlahu wa-lā basharun yarāh.
verses.en: And when he placed his noble hand upon a child’s head, the child could be distinguished from among the other children by the fragrance left by his touch. His noble face shone with the radiance of the moon on a full-moon night. And one who described him said, “I have never seen anyone like him, before him or after him, nor will any human being ever see his like.”

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
